# format-literals

render_literals(template) is a small renderer for only the documented Git pretty-format literal codes: %n, %%, and %x followed by exactly two hexadecimal digits. Input contains ASCII ordinary text and valid codes in this subset; every percent starts a valid code. Decode each input code once, left to right, without reinterpreting emitted characters. Return a Python str whose characters have the decoded ASCII byte values (hex values are 00 through 7F). Do not invoke git.

Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/git/git/v2.46.0/Documentation/pretty-formats.txt
Run: `python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests`. Keep the public interface and original tests. Standard library/built-ins only; no network or git in application code. Runtime artifacts belong in the system temporary directory.
